item.title: I was fined £500 after putting a coffee cup in a rubbish bag next to a full bin
item.summary: Reader expresses consternation after enforcement officer issues penalty notice outside station in London I was outside London Waterloo railway station and was looking for a bin to dispose of an empty coffee cup. The only bin I could see was completely full, but there was a plastic bag containing rubbish at the base. Continue reading...
